findings.note: Comment claim that the code does not have: profile_test.go:97-98 says the old behaviour meant 'the per-file table stopped summing to FilteredDiffBytes', implying the fix restores that invariant. It does not hold in either direction, and nothing pins it. Measured in a scratch copy of the package with one branch-and-dirty file (400 branch bytes, 102 local) plus one worktree-only file (126 bytes): FilteredDiffBytes=628, sum(DiffBytes)=526 (the branch file's DiffBytes is overwritten with the branch total at profile.go:197, so its local bytes are missing), sum(DiffBytes)+sum(LocalBytes)=754 (the worktree-only file's bytes are counted twice, because for a non-branch path DiffBytes already contains the local contribution). There is also no per-file byte table anywhere: Markdown(profile) (profile.go:112-133) prints only totals, reviewmanifest renders path lists only (manifest.go:262-306), and PlanShards packs from branchFiles rather than profile.Files (shards.go:188-203). The tested half of the comment (LocalBytes disclosure) is accurate and effective; only the summing rationale is false.

evidence.note: 'the per-file table stopped summing to FilteredDiffBytes' - an invariant no code establishes and no test asserts.
filteredDiffBytes = branch + len(StagedDiff)+len(WorkingTreeDiff)+len(UntrackedExcerpts), i.e. whole-text lengths, while the per-file numbers are per-path parses - the two accountings cannot agree.

findings.note: Assertion that cannot fail: profile_test.go:119 ('a branch-committed file is still a branch file') is satisfied by two independent paths for this fixture. sourceOf (profile.go:277-281) already returns SourceBranch because 'src/both.go' is in ChangedFiles, and the branch arm then forces file.Source = SourceBranch unconditionally (profile.go:204). findings.note: Truncation is invisible to the judge, and the golden is the proof. fixedInputs[KindStillPresent] (judge_test.go:96) sets DiffTruncated: true, yet the rendered prompt in this golden carries no truncation notice anywhere: the diff fence is introduced as 'Current diff (base..HEAD, after fixes were applied)' and the model is asked whether the bug STILL EXISTS. RenderPrompt (internal/fsm/judge/prompts.go:186-196) never reads si.DiffTruncated, so a still-present call whose evidence fell past the 30,000-byte CutDiff boundary asks a complete-looking question over an incomplete diff, and stillPresentExec (internal/fsm/kind/kind.go:587-595) records only StillPresent/Confidence per bug - the truncation flag survives only in the input hash and the CLI env (internal/fsm/cli/run.go:801). The omission is defensible: TestJ1Provenance pins the templates byte-for-byte to harnesseval@19ff9a8, so adding a line would break provenance. Raised as a risk to track rather than a change to make on this branch.

evidence.note: 'Current diff (base..HEAD, after fixes were applied)' - rendered from an input with DiffTruncated: true, with no indication the diff was cut.
still-present fills only golden_comment and diff; DiffTruncated is carried in the struct but never reaches the prompt.
